text:
Alex M: CI smoke on main is red for the Hosted API integration tests (shard 12). Failing pattern: auth errors + streaming toolcall schema mismatch. Can someone rerun shard12 and/or kick off a bisect?

ci-bot: Job failed: hosted-integ/shard-12 (flake-priority). Summary: 14 tests failed, 9 related to auth token (401), 5 to toolcall payload validation. Logs: https://ci.redwood.run/build/3812

Sanjay K: I saw a deploy to auth-proxy last night around 01:10 UTC. @lina any schema work merged yesterday that could break tool-call payloads? :thinking_face:

Lina R: I merged a small schema tightening in models-api yesterday (PR #842) — changed required field "tool_specs" -> now required nested keys. That could cause validation failures if the runtime sends the older shape.

Sam D: Re-ran the failing shard locally against staging-hosted. Got same 401 for streaming setup step:
```
2026-03-16T01:22:11Z ERROR auth: token exchange failed status=401 {"error":"invalid_scope","msg":"missing scope:stream.write"}
```

Sam D: Command to rerun CI shard (web): https://ci.redwood.run/retry?job=hosted-integ/shard-12 or CLI: `./scripts/ci retry --job hosted-integ --shard 12`

qa-runner: Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood.run/artifacts/3812/shard-12/ (gzipped logs + failing request/response pairs)

Alex M: Ok — two root causes suspected: (1) auth-proxy change dropped stream.write scope mapping, (2) models-api schema tightening causes toolcall payload reject. We should bisect the auth-proxy deploy first since more failures are 401. Anyone oncall for infra to revert or patch mapping?

Sanjay K: I can take the proxy bisect. Starting with commits from 01:00–01:30 UTC. If anyone can hold off merges to models-api for 30m that'd help.

Lina R: Pausing models-api merges now. If you need a quick workaround we can relax the schema check on the receiver to accept the older key shape for a short window.

Alex M: Thanks — Sam can you kick a rerun after the proxy revert? Also please add a short PR to models-api to add a compatibility shim if the schema change is the culprit.

Sam D: Will do. Kicking rerun now after proxy rollback attempt.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered: hosted-integ/shard-12 (build 3813). Monitor: https://ci.redwood.run/build/3813

Alex M: Great. If rerun passes we still should plan a controlled rollout for schema enforcement. If it fails, we'll start a full bisect across the last 3 deploys. :thumbsup:
